subject.title: [Feature]: Allow job-level model override for cron jobs using sessionTarget=main + payload.kind=systemEvent

question: Should OpenClaw support explicit provider/model overrides for main-session `systemEvent` cron jobs, and should the public contract be `payload.model`, top-level cron fields, or a `sessionOverride` block?
rationale: Current code and docs intentionally treat system events as text-only main-session injections, while the requested fix crosses provider routing, cron persistence, heartbeat execution, session state, CLI/UI, and upgrade semantics that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Design an explicit override contract
options.body: Add a public cron-owned provider/model override shape, validate it like isolated cron payload models, and prove main-session wake modes do not leak or corrupt session state.

options.title: Keep systemEvent text-only
options.body: Document this path as unsupported and steer cheap scheduled model calls to isolated/current/custom-session `agentTurn` jobs.

options.title: Fold into broader cron schema work
options.body: Decide model, context, timeout, and spend semantics together with the broader cron schema/cost-control trackers.

recommendation.title: Design an explicit override contract
recommendation.body: Add a public cron-owned provider/model override shape, validate it like isolated cron payload models, and prove main-session wake modes do not leak or corrupt session state.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing candidate from related model-override and Cron UI/product history, while the final choice is product/API direction rather than a mechanical code repair.
